correctness.rationale: Seven orthogonal normalized harmonic cubics; parity reduces to one scalar and three 2-by-2 blocks; cap polar integrations produce all six rational-polynomial functions. All 28 independent Gram-product identities were checked algebraically, including norms, trace and derivative. An explicit strict monotonicity H prime forces equal thresholds whenever the operator could be scalar, and the equal-width scalar/one-vector spectral gap has a fixed nonzero sign. Nonempty open observed and unobserved regions guarantee all eigenvalues in (0,1). Four independent angular-polar quadratures agreed entrywise to 1.5e-15. Exact proof holds for all parameters, not just samples.
